Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 10, "heading": "CHAPTER 8. MY HOLIDAYS. ESPECIALLY ONE HAPPY AFTERNOON", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u010-b0062", "target": "Мы сидели вокруг огня и чудесно беседовали. Я рассказал им, каким суровым хозяином был мистер Крикл, и они очень меня жалели. Я рассказал им, какой замечательный малый Стирфорт и какой он мой покровитель, и Пегготи сказала, что прошла бы два десятка миль, лишь бы его увидеть. Я брал малютку на руки, когда он просыпался, и ласково нянчил его. Когда он снова засыпал, я подсаживался поближе к маме, по моему старому обычаю, давно уже нарушенному, и сидел, обнимая её за талию, прижавшись своей маленькой красной щекой к её плечу, и снова чувствовал, как её прекрасные волосы ниспадают на меня — как ангельское крыло, как я, помнится, думал тогда, — и был поистине очень счастлив.", "source_sha256": "945cbd9f6ef8d035834ba6efc07e68a316d7a05248e727ef09c3514f655fe430", "target_id": "ru-en85-u010-b0062", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "13748dc93bac5229257fde182d89d577502c00ec703cdcb5fa067e7e6a73ab7f"}, {"source_id": "en85-u010-b0063", "target": "Сидя так, глядя на огонь и видя картины в раскалённых углях, я почти поверил, что никуда не уезжал; что мистер и мисс Мэрдстон — такие же картины и исчезнут, когда огонь прогорит; и что во всём, что я помнил, нет ничего настоящего, кроме мамы, Пегготи и меня.", "source_sha256": "3460ad506648854c4260fde96e63a49a1635caec711f9ee2ecc411890d744982", "target_id": "ru-en85-u010-b0063", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "ddb4ea177afc9eeb4dde0307799d3b02b0aab363cff95f35406b674520dd7ab0"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 8, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u010-b0064", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Peggotty darned away at a stocking as long as she could see, and then sat with it drawn on her left hand like a glove, and her needle in her right, ready to take another stitch whenever there was a blaze. I cannot conceive whose stockings they can have been that Peggotty was always darning, or where such an unfailing supply of stockings in want of darning can have come from. From my earliest infancy she seems to have been always employed in that class of needlework, and never by any chance in any other.", "sha256": "7f68dc26e5a57cbe76f83916593f9d15b8ac00029b66420db435ca14851f12b1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[65]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0065", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I wonder,’ said Peggotty, who was sometimes seized with a fit of wondering on some most unexpected topic, ‘what’s become of Davy’s great-aunt?’ ‘Lor, Peggotty!’ observed my mother, rousing herself from a reverie, ‘what nonsense you talk!’", "sha256": "6702fa5bc3570fb96723619f6a4b86f2381fd3aca3af44968a0021b7a0cbdca2", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[66]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0066", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Well, but I really do wonder, ma’am,’ said Peggotty.", "sha256": "b447cc335afa3622352573d4c9a8d8f2b4bcf39ef3a618f61faede7560cee2fa", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[67]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0067", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What can have put such a person in your head?’ inquired my mother. ‘Is there nobody else in the world to come there?’", "sha256": "3f53674ea76bfa393f82043d51564493204aff3df856c0374cedf51621e7f044", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[68]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0068", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I don’t know how it is,’ said Peggotty, ‘unless it’s on account of being stupid, but my head never can pick and choose its people. They come and they go, and they don’t come and they don’t go, just as they like. I wonder what’s become of her?’", "sha256": "fd922761505a6a670bd2b4c1e00eec80c6bf01fa597f931a903a29b5c5cc5de3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[69]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0069", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘How absurd you are, Peggotty!’ returned my mother. ‘One would suppose you wanted a second visit from her.’", "sha256": "951025ed4f3ad7950ddf213b88b880df984061c5ec30f116317dbaae2d929bc4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[70]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0070", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Lord forbid!’ cried Peggotty.", "sha256": "b3240376d624d6011f53b9b81c38a5c4d1a11450ff6fccd1c1c7c05c87e40cce", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[71]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0071", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Well then, don’t talk about such uncomfortable things, there’s a good soul,’ said my mother. ‘Miss Betsey is shut up in her cottage by the sea, no doubt, and will remain there. At all events, she is not likely ever to trouble us again.’", "sha256": "723a9e715c6785e260252abaeeb7a40a87fcb47dee6ccd83f2bdd830758c235a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[72]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0072", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No!’ mused Peggotty. ‘No, that ain’t likely at all.—-I wonder, if she was to die, whether she’d leave Davy anything?’", "sha256": "d959ecbcead93a0cfd84058e4eaead421cbe0deb3bd8c99a36c844a3dce4304b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[73]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0073", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Good gracious me, Peggotty,’ returned my mother, ‘what a nonsensical woman you are! when you know that she took offence at the poor dear boy’s ever being born at all.’", "sha256": "a516a461b2c3306c9f532900b548988add206272b3f0a2e13c078f5ec10e871f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[74]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0074", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I suppose she wouldn’t be inclined to forgive him now,’ hinted Peggotty.", "sha256": "ef524598a7f4325062e74b42e0b5a5a5588f596b464ee67c32958a8abcef315a", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[75]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0075", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Why should she be inclined to forgive him now?’ said my mother, rather sharply.", "sha256": "a39f412b8fb1b338a6d1b9b3f7baa05a060899949084f6a33d6c85c9a4b25ba7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[76]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0076", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Now that he’s got a brother, I mean,’ said Peggotty.", "sha256": "b57418eacbbf978eaa1d8773931b37299354c6b24b1c16a2a8d88fdb5484fbd7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[77]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0077", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "My mother immediately began to cry, and wondered how Peggotty dared to say such a thing.", "sha256": "b1cf5fd39d92b0da813ccfacbbc36c3ab509bd4ae0f725a53366cf84567817d1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[78]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0078", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘As if this poor little innocent in its cradle had ever done any harm to you or anybody else, you jealous thing!’ said she. ‘You had much better go and marry Mr. Barkis, the carrier. Why don’t you?’", "sha256": "ae382de8708058bbdd1115c9918b4336f5a7e7580990aefd73bd8156719a381f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[79]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0079", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I should make Miss Murdstone happy, if I was to,’ said Peggotty.", "sha256": "78906235935bc6ab88462a73479ce60f8d6acc179b4d3e040422d02f2c0d1112", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[80]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0080", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘What a bad disposition you have, Peggotty!’ returned my mother. ‘You are as jealous of Miss Murdstone as it is possible for a ridiculous creature to be. You want to keep the keys yourself, and give out all the things, I suppose? I shouldn’t be surprised if you did. When you know that she only does it out of kindness and the best intentions! You know she does, Peggotty—you know it well.’", "sha256": "1d2846eb3fd7f24641ba5ae7fc4752f1609e92b32ab19046f18028e07d783630", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[81]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0081", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Peggotty muttered something to the effect of ‘Bother the best intentions!’ and something else to the effect that there was a little too much of the best intentions going on.", "sha256": "22bead7cea6f17dfcedf4bfc9935668914e8665c3932f243d62d2fb2630f0405", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[82]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0082", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I know what you mean, you cross thing,’ said my mother. ‘I understand you, Peggotty, perfectly. You know I do, and I wonder you don’t colour up like fire. But one point at a time. Miss Murdstone is the point now, Peggotty, and you sha’n’t escape from it. Haven’t you heard her say, over and over again, that she thinks I am too thoughtless and too—a—a—’", "sha256": "bc33d0dd7320bede6a6814be50e7654372777dceec769c5cbca1d740200ddbb5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[83]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0083", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Pretty,’ suggested Peggotty.", "sha256": "d0d59714a398310052aca554c5b3544fbb839e180615d1aa530081ba848cc474", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[84]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0084", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Well,’ returned my mother, half laughing, ‘and if she is so silly as to say so, can I be blamed for it?’", "sha256": "dd8e3d3e67252b7ffacd97ccc610af6376bac08919f7bf6b8b004412d36d13ca", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[85]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0085", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No one says you can,’ said Peggotty.", "sha256": "4e085e0366944967e8935e8e00856a6471600442e175124b10f43817242985fb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[86]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0086", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No, I should hope not, indeed!’ returned my mother. ‘Haven’t you heard her say, over and over again, that on this account she wished to spare me a great deal of trouble, which she thinks I am not suited for, and which I really don’t know myself that I AM suited for; and isn’t she up early and late, and going to and fro continually—and doesn’t she do all sorts of things, and grope into all sorts of places, coal-holes and pantries and I don’t know where, that can’t be very agreeable—and do you mean to insinuate that there is not a sort of devotion in that?’", "sha256": "0e77e802c5ec5f8863ec495c655de45af6979f67f7f2d06aa581990083862819", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[87]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0087", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I don’t insinuate at all,’ said Peggotty.", "sha256": "df7ba2c2eb2e4222f6efd3a2bb7763ecfca4e1e3152a594497958853ed1939a1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[88]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0088", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You do, Peggotty,’ returned my mother. ‘You never do anything else, except your work. You are always insinuating. You revel in it. And when you talk of Mr. Murdstone’s good intentions—’", "sha256": "ddd7e7a7345ae2f35fd5ed759680c88030b79a46c1ebb791815b96bcf8eed675", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[89]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0089", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I never talked of ‘em,’ said Peggotty.", "sha256": "f7fdb81ecd2f995fb56200d5b571dda3cdeca616dfeab9b761b30497131d6d98", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[90]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0090", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No, Peggotty,’ returned my mother, ‘but you insinuated. That’s what I told you just now. That’s the worst of you. You WILL insinuate. I said, at the moment, that I understood you, and you see I did. When you talk of Mr. Murdstone’s good intentions, and pretend to slight them (for I don’t believe you really do, in your heart, Peggotty), you must be as well convinced as I am how good they are, and how they actuate him in everything. If he seems to have been at all stern with a certain person, Peggotty—you understand, and so I am sure does Davy, that I am not alluding to anybody present—it is solely because he is satisfied that it is for a certain person’s benefit. He naturally loves a certain person, on my account; and acts solely for a certain person’s good. He is better able to judge of it than I am; for I very well know that I am a weak, light, girlish creature, and that he is a firm, grave, serious man. And he takes,’ said my mother, with the tears which were engendered in her affectionate nature, stealing down her face, ‘he takes great pains with me; and I ought to be very thankful to him, and very submissive to him even in my thoughts; and when I am not, Peggotty, I worry and condemn myself, and feel doubtful of my own heart, and don’t know what to do.’", "sha256": "4c55a627b0e8305ba6e2781cdd680c4f689a427b01154a14641c9da0cac714d6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[91]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0091", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Peggotty sat with her chin on the foot of the stocking, looking silently at the fire.", "sha256": "86330819b560aa006cc79c81b7494675a47919cd44a9091c86d2e43441e3e977", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[92]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0092", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘There, Peggotty,’ said my mother, changing her tone, ‘don’t let us fall out with one another, for I couldn’t bear it. You are my true friend, I know, if I have any in the world. When I call you a ridiculous creature, or a vexatious thing, or anything of that sort, Peggotty, I only mean that you are my true friend, and always have been, ever since the night when Mr. Copperfield first brought me home here, and you came out to the gate to meet me.’", "sha256": "5962c30a1fc818af0ff56721238e966a0deedae5c9e973ad02594e2958852bc4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[93]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0093", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Peggotty was not slow to respond, and ratify the treaty of friendship by giving me one of her best hugs. I think I had some glimpses of the real character of this conversation at the time; but I am sure, now, that the good creature originated it, and took her part in it, merely that my mother might comfort herself with the little contradictory summary in which she had indulged. The design was efficacious; for I remember that my mother seemed more at ease during the rest of the evening, and that Peggotty observed her less.", "sha256": "8296a9841a2feaa97be8e6a7d4d96bd09d6668452bdf95abe2255352dae46acb", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[94]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0094", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "When we had had our tea, and the ashes were thrown up, and the candles snuffed, I read Peggotty a chapter out of the Crocodile Book, in remembrance of old times—she took it out of her pocket: I don’t know whether she had kept it there ever since—and then we talked about Salem House, which brought me round again to Steerforth, who was my great subject. We were very happy; and that evening, as the last of its race, and destined evermore to close that volume of my life, will never pass out of my memory.", "sha256": "06e96ec9b2e5caaff55bc218d27532bc743348525a795a6001d238b18fb21eee", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[95]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u010-b0095", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "It was almost ten o’clock before we heard the sound of wheels. We all got up then; and my mother said hurriedly that, as it was so late, and Mr. and Miss Murdstone approved of early hours for young people, perhaps I had better go to bed. I kissed her, and went upstairs with my candle directly, before they came in. It appeared to my childish fancy, as I ascended to the bedroom where I had been imprisoned, that they brought a cold blast of air into the house which blew away the old familiar feeling like a feather.", "sha256": "9057d586e2c60effe8ce6c4b01fa3c8c36b2b0761069d4842b627655053a5c6c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[15]/p[96]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
